widgets_values:
These are good resolutions to gen in. They are all divisible by 16.

Note: the largest 16:9 resolution is slightly off (1088 instead of 1080) in order to be divisible by 16. Remember to cut the extra 8 pixels off afterwards if you need perfect 16:9.
If you're using a GGUF model, swap the model loader node to a "Unet Loader (GGUF)" node instead. You need the 'ComfyUI-GGUF' custom nodes installed to do that.

nodes.title: Negative Prompts?
widgets_values:
You can use negative prompts if you're using the RAW main model with the turbo lora.

To do this, you need to set the CFG to ~2.0 strength. This will 'enable' CFG which makes negative prompts work, but be aware that this will **double** the time it takes to generate an image.

Isometric video game asset of an Omnidirectional Pulse Spire. A compact area-suppression turret with a circular base and clearly visible energy-storage coils integrated into the foundation. The central spire is built from stacked, glowing energy rings that rise vertically in a clean, compact silhouette. Omnidirectional firing ports are embedded into the gaps between the rings, designed to project electric pulses in a full 360-degree wave. The turret should read as idle and static, with no motion, no steam, no fire, and no animated effects.

Zen-Cyber Minimalism aesthetic. Use a restrained palette of #FFFFFF, #F2F2F2, and #007AFF. Combine frosted glass, brushed aerospace-grade aluminum, and soft-touch matte polymers with ultra-clean forms, soft diffused bloom, and subtle fresnel reflections. Keep the design sleek, futuristic, and highly legible at low resolution. Emphasize cartoony chibi proportions so the asset remains readable and charming when shrunk. Strong isometric perspective with clear, game-ready shape language and crisp edges.

Solid bright magenta background #FF00FF single tone with no gradients. Compact sprite-like presentation, clean separation from the background, consistent proportions, and polished 3D game asset rendering.
